claims.claim: Retrieval strengthens access to studied material by requiring an attempt to remember, whereas spacing distributes attempts over time. In research on learning techniques, practice testing and distributed practice show broad utility. Their effect depends on content, timing, prior knowledge and the test. Use corrective feedback so mistakes do not remain unchallenged. A schedule of day 1, 3, 7 and 30 is a starting plan, not an empirically universal optimum. A card asking why or how can test understanding better than a card containing only a definition.
